citation: G. C. Kennedy and R. N. Keeler, Compressibility, in American Institute of Physics Handbook, 3rd ed., D. E. Gray (ed.), McGraw-Hill, 1972
table: 4d-12, Relative volumes of solids at 25 C
units_and_normalization: P in kbar; V/V0 dimensionless; GPa=P_kbar/10; T=25 C=298.15 K
phase_annotation: Table labels elements only; phase identity not explicitly supplied for these columns. Do not infer a crystallographic model from the table alone.
kind: Published calculated isotherms reduced from experimental shock data, not original shock observations or independent static volume measurements

method.shock_data_ancestor: M. van Thiel, Compendium of Shock Wave Data, UCRL-50108, 1966 (Sec.4d-2 ref.1)
method.experimental_laboratories: Livermore, Los Alamos, Ballistics Research Laboratory and Soviet Union; selected for completeness, accuracy and absence of large error sources (p.4-96)
method.gamma_law: Volume-only gamma linked to curvature of the 0 K pressure curve by Eq.4d-6, t=1 (Dugdale-MacDonald); not constant gamma or constant rho*gamma
method.thermal_step: Solve 0 K curve and gamma(V), then add the 25 C thermal energy correction via Eq.4d-7
method.strength: Finite yield-strength corrections neglected for these metals; source applies a strength correction to Al2O3 separately
method.phase_limit: Source warns about phase changes and melting along the Hugoniot; the approximation is not experimental proof of a single phase

uncertainty.source_accuracy_statement: p.4-98 estimates calculated 25 C isotherms probably accurate to +/-5 percent in pressure, certainly better than +/-10 percent
uncertainty.semantics: Qualitative method-level estimate, not per-row standard deviations, confidence intervals or covariance; no per-cell uncertainty supplied
uncertainty.OCR_caution: Printed 5 percent is repeatedly misread as .5 percent in the OCR. Checked visually; do not report 0.5 percent. Likewise printed 25 C can appear as 2.5 C.
uncertainty.printed_volume_precision: Three decimals in V/V0; numerical display precision is not a supplied measurement error

visual_checks: Complete relevant pages inspected, including table titles and column alignment
Ag at 400 kbar is 0.811; OCR 0.1811 rejected using printed pixels
Co/Ni lower 5/10-kbar cells are empty; no zero-pressure anchor synthesized
unrecovered: Original selected shock experiments and pointwise reduction arrays from UCRL-50108
Per-row covariance or statistically defined uncertainties
Dewaele sample mask, interpolation grid, fitting weights, averaging and original worksheet
scope: Source recovery only; no new refit, graph correction, EOS recommendation or catalogue change
